nora_csm: Heads-up: Copperline usage dropped ~66% over the past 9 days. Main champion (Erin) left last week and procurement has kicked off a short test with VectorLabs. Marking renewal-risk and opening triage. :warning:
ben_sales: thanks for the ping. do we have active seats and whether it's a full migration or just a pilot? :eyes:
alerts_bot: Snapshot: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/copperline/usage (14d: -66% tokens, seats 14 -> 5) :bar_chart:
alejandra_cs: I'll own outreach. propose quick steps: 1) 20m reconnect with new ML lead + procurement; 2) ask for top 5 prompts + confirm SSO/workflow status; 3) offer a small promo credit for a 1-week Dedicated canary if they commit to enablement and exec sync.
kevin_eng: No model regressions on our side. I do see a collapse in scheduled background jobs and some 403s in auth logs around the time Erin left. running a short query to export hits.
nora_csm: Ben, can you pre-approve promo credit up to $4k as credits (legal prefers credits)? sales okay to condition on verbal commit?
ben_sales: OK to approve up to $4k in credits contingent on enablement + exec sync. I'll prep a short commercial note to send after verbal.
alejandra_cs: Asking the customer to run this quick diagnostic and paste output in thread:
alejandra_cs: ```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/accounts/copperline/diagnostic \
  -d '{"sample_days":7}'
```
alerts_bot: QBR slot available Fri 14:00-14:30 via /calendar book. Renewal tickler set for 72h follow-up. :calendar:
alejandra_cs: Reached out to new contact (Ian P.), proposed Tue/Wed 20m slots. will update once they respond. Target: enablement + exec sync this week, then reassess renewal trajectory. :rocket:
